Container.Name: blockbusterr
Container.Overview: Automatically discovers trending, popular, and highly-rated movies and TV shows (via Trakt, TMDB, or Simkl) and adds them to Radarr/Sonarr, or creates Jellyseerr requests for approval. Configure Radarr/Sonarr connections, discovery sources, filters (genre, rating, year, runtime, language), and cron-scheduled jobs (e.g. a daily top-25 job) entirely through the web UI after first launch. No built-in authentication - intended for a trusted LAN only, do not expose this WebUI directly to the internet.
Container.Requires: A running Radarr and/or Sonarr instance reachable on your network. Optionally: Jellyseerr (for request-approval workflow instead of direct add), and a free API app from whichever discovery source you pick (Trakt, TMDB, or Simkl).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web UI listens on inside the container

Config.Name: External Config
Config.Description: Optional: mount a config.yaml here to manage settings as a file instead of only via the web UI

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for cron job scheduling

Config.Name: Disable UI
Config.Description: Set true to run headless once jobs are configured (web UI stays reachable for editing unless you also block the port)
